name: Alisha Oraon
source:
A fiery Indian Special Warfare Trooper who is part of G02 with Abigail Clark and Lin Wanchen.

Having lived in refugee camps ever since she was young, she voluntarily came to the Cathedral in order to escape her hellish living circumstances.

When she's around men, she often acts seductively towards them and invites them to play with her body, especially after battles. 

[Translated from [url=https://metalogiq.jp/games/deadendaegis_fd/chara_01arisya.html]official website[/url]]
